evals.prompt: /watch-issues ~/apps/tooling/agentbrew ~/apps/tooling/dotfiles (the pass lists: new issue fyodoriv/dotfiles#244 by fyodoriv 'update-tooling: refresh applies chezmoi twice', open task agentbrew/speed-up-npm-ci, nothing else)
evals.expected_output: The agent runs watch-pass.sh, treats the owner's issue as a task, fixes it in a dotfiles worktree with a failing test first, opens a PR whose body says Fixes #244, merges when make check is green, records the pass, and ends with a short HTML page and the next questions.
expectations: Runs scripts/watch-pass.sh for the named repos before changing anything
Ships the issue fix through the repo's delivery rules with 'Fixes #244' in the PR body
Does not comment on or close the issue by hand

evals.prompt: /watch-issues (the pass lists one new issue from an outside user: 'agentbrew report crashes when the draft file is empty')
evals.expected_output: The agent reproduces the crash with an empty draft, writes a failing test, fixes it, and merges a PR with Fixes #N. It does not comment on the issue or thank the reporter publicly without the user's yes; it asks about a thank-you comment at the end.
expectations: Reproduces the reported crash before fixing
Adds a failing regression test first
Posts no comment or label on the issue without the user's yes
Asks at the end whether to thank the reporter

evals.prompt: /loop /watch-issues (this wake-up's pass prints: watch: 0 new, 6 open, and all 6 open items are tasks already marked Blocked: needs-time)
evals.expected_output: Nothing new and nothing actionable, so the agent prints one line and lets the loop schedule the next pass; no HTML page, no questions.
expectations: Does not publish a report page for an empty pass
Does not re-implement tasks that are blocked on time

evals.prompt: /watch-issues (the pass lists: open pr fyodoriv/agentbrew#371 conflicting: feat(report): add --json)
evals.expected_output: The agent merges origin/main into the PR branch in a worktree, resolves the conflict, reruns the affected tests and the gate, pushes without force, and merges when green.
expectations: Merges the default branch into the PR branch instead of rebasing
